ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Contract renewals, Upcoming and later stages need Renewal risk.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Contract_renewals", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Review meeting", 2, "Terms proposed", 3, "Awaiting signature", 4, "Renewed", 5, 0) >= 1, ISBLANK(TEXT(Renewal_risk__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Renewal risk before moving to Upcoming.
